scope.behavior_assumptions: Checkout endpoints will use D1 batching. Webhook will process Stripe events. Cron will mark old orders abandoned.

execution.config: Set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET via `wrangler secret put STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` on Cloudflare Dashboard manually (Do not hardcode in CI).
execution.migration: D1 migrations run automatically via `deploy.yml` CI pipeline.
execution.feature_flag_controls: Managed via `settings` table in D1. Init script required to insert `checkout-v2` = true after successful canary test.

order_sensitive_steps: 1. Run D1 migrations (creating settings table & inventory_reservations if not exist)
smoke_checks_required: Verify Stripe Webhook returns 200 OK for test events
Verify Checkout V1 still works before enabling V2 flag
impact_review.rollback_blockers: Once stock is decremented via V2, rolling back to V1 might cause mismatch in inventory state if V1 does not check `inventory_reservations`.

verification.logs_and_dashboards: Monitor Cloudflare Analytics for 5xx errors. Monitor `audit_logs` table for Stripe Event processing success.

rollback.code_or_config_rollback: Update D1 `settings` table to set `checkout-v2` = false to instantly revert to old behavior.
rollback.data_considerations: If rolling back, ensure pending `inventory_reservations` from V2 are either cleared or ignored by V1.
